description: This Java class defines a custom exception, TooManyRequestsException, used in the Eclipse Ditto project to indicate that too many requests (e.g., via WebSocket) have been made in a short period. It includes facilities for building instances with optional headers, messages, descriptions, and retry durations, and integrates with the Ditto exception hierarchy.

classes.name: TooManyRequestsException
classes.description: A custom exception class representing a 'Too Many Requests' error, including the possibility to specify a retry-after duration and custom headers.

classes.name: TooManyRequestsException.Builder
classes.description: A builder class for creating instances of TooManyRequestsException with optional additional headers and retry-after information.

methods.name: public static Builder newBuilder()
methods.description: Creates a new builder instance for constructing a TooManyRequestsException.

methods.name: public static TooManyRequestsException fromMessage(String message, DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Constructs a TooManyRequestsException with a specific message and headers.

methods.name: public static TooManyRequestsException fromJson(JsonObject jsonObject, DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Constructs a TooManyRequestsException based on a JSON object representing an error.

methods.name: public DittoRuntimeException setDittoHeaders(DittoHeaders dittoHeaders)
methods.description: Returns a new exception instance with updated headers.
